2608.16686.title: Closing the Affective Loop: Multimodal Speaker-Listener Emotion-Dynamics-Aware Empathetic Social Robots
2608.16686.paper_summary: Empathetic social robots should respond not only to what users say, but also to how their emotions dynamically evolve during interaction. However, existing empathetic dialogue systems are often text-centered and primarily model empathy as a one-way mapping from the user's emotion to the system response, limiting their ability to capture embodied speaker--listener affective exchange. We present AffectLoop, a multimodal speaker-listener emotion-dynamics-aware spoken dialogue system implemented on the Misty II robot. The system tracks the speaker's verbal and facial affective dynamics, estimates the robot listener's own verbal and behavioral affective state, and conditions LLM-based response generation on both affective streams. The robot then generates a short spoken empathetic response together with emotionally congruent embodied behavior, forming a closed speaker--listener affective loop. We evaluate the system in a pilot within-subject study with five participants, comparing it with an otherwise identical utterance-conditioned baseline that omits the speaker- and listener-affective-state inputs. The proposed system received higher overall impression ratings, especially for empathetic response and user satisfaction. Post-hoc log analysis further showed higher speaker-listener affective alignment and stronger valence-based distress recovery. These preliminary results suggest that explicitly modeling both speaker emotional dynamics and listener affective state can improve embodied empathetic interaction.
2608.16686.paper_summary_zh: 同理心社交機器人應該不僅回應用戶所說的話，還要回應他們在互動過程中情感的動態演變。然而，現有的同理心對話系統往往以文本為中心，主要將同理心建模為用戶情感到系統回應的單向映射，限制了它們捕捉具體的說話者與聽眾之間情感交流的能力。我們提出了AffectLoop，一個多模態的說話者-聽眾情感動態感知的口語對話系統，實現在Misty II機器人上。該系統追踪說話者的口頭和面部情感動態，估計機器人聽眾自身的口頭和行為情感狀態，並根據這兩個情感流來調整基於LLM的回應生成。然後，機器人生成一個簡短的口語同理心回應，並伴隨著情感一致的具體行為，形成一個封閉的說話者-聽眾情感循環。我們在一項包含五名參與者的先導內部研究中評估該系統，並將其與一個省略說話者和聽眾情感狀態輸入的其他相同的語句條件基線進行比較。所提出的系統獲得了更高的整體印象評分，特別是在同理心回應和用戶滿意度方面。事後日誌分析進一步顯示出更高的說話者-聽眾情感對齊和更強的基於價值的痛苦恢復。這些初步結果表明，明確建模說話者情感動態和聽眾情感狀態可以改善具體的同理心互動。
